top: A wildlife photographer took this close-up of a silverback gorilla in Rwanda. One second later…
comment: …the gorilla punched him in the face. Christophe Courteau walked away with a small scar on his forehead, and the photo of a lifetime.
topic_it: Il fotografo Christophe Courteau fotografa il silverback Akarevuro nel Parco dei Vulcani (Rwanda) un attimo prima di ricevere un pugno
